title_short: Vishal · There Is No Typical Day
length: about 46 s plus the end card
headline: Kiva's CEO on his days: there is no typical one, but every day is full of meaningful conversations, and sometimes good, sometimes hard decisions.
story: Light and human: the kind of post that makes a CEO feel like a person. Cold open on “Honestly, there isn't a typical day.” Then who he talks to, what he does when he travels, and the button: “and sometimes good, sometimes hard decisions.”
Where it stands: Kiva approved this cut and has downloaded and catalogued it in its library. Nothing more is asked. This page is the plan of record.
do: Keep the approved cut. Do not start a new edit unless Nick asks.

Caption the travel line as he says it: “decisions. Sometimes I'm traveling,”
Clear space between “it is” and between every word in the captions.
End on “and sometimes good, sometimes hard decisions.”
dont: No “Oops, so I'm telling the secrets now” aside at the top.
